notes: Scope: Workspace.Gwangalli.pcbang (광안 PC방 + 광안타워) and Workspace.Gwangalli.karaoke (광안 코인노래연습장 + 광안빌딩). Both buildings face -Z (street side z<267); PC방 yaw ≈180.4°, karaoke exactly 180°. Interior floor top y 6.85 and ceiling underside y 17.95 (11.1 studs ≈ 3.3 m) in both; walk-in venues are ground floor only. Upper floors (광안타워 2F-5F, 광안빌딩 2F-4F), both building lobbies and both side shops (광안 분식, 광안 마라탕) cannot be entered: their glass Door parts keep the default CanCollide=true, they have no AutoDoor tag, and Annex skips host venues 'pcbang'/'karaoke'. Biggest gameplay holes: (1) the PC client is a placeholder (GwangalliVenues/PC.luau, 18 lines), so 'PC 켜기' takes 1,000원, seats you and then shows nothing; (2) every PCStation AislePos is mirrored about z≈266.5, so the food clerk tweens out through the front glass into the street and back; (3) ShopStaff treats each venue model's side shop (분식/마라탕) as the storefront and puts a PC방/노래방-style 알바생 there; (4) karaoke signs say 1곡 500원 / 4곡 1,000원 but rental is 500원 per 30 in-game minutes. Part budget today: PC방 ≈1,577 interior parts (PCHall 1,218, of which 48 PCs x 23 = 1,104); karaoke ≈1,149 (8 booths x 83 = 664, 856 including the booth sub-models). Upgrades should be client-local near-only overlays (Workspace.GwInteriorDetailLocal, NearLOD/ZoneLOD radii 66-110), hiding crude originals per rules R1-R7 in bld/systems.json: inside ZoneLOD/NearLOD roots that are not arrive-hidden, use local Transparency=1 and disable SurfaceGuis yourself. Never hide PCStation Seat/Keyboard/MonitorScreen, KaraokePanel/KaraokeZone/KaraokeScreen/StatusLight/MirrorBall, Seats, TableTops or VenueSpot/VenueBoard/VenueStaff; overlay nicer non-colliding copies at the same pose instead. KaraokeScreen and MonitorScreen carry client-built SurfaceGuis (KaraokeTV, future PC desktop): keep the face (Back) and size or move the gui with the overlay. New lights should be few and tagged InteriorLight (global budget nearest 24/16/6) and rely on Neon emissive. Space per real-world scale: 1 stud ≈ 0.3 m; a PC seat pitch of 4.8 studs ≈ 1.45 m is wide (real ≈ 0.9-1.1 m), and karaoke booths ≈ 5.2x3.5 m are normal-노래방 size, not coin-booth size. Keep the existing footprints (gameplay zones depend on them) and fill them with detail, plus couple/premium seating as decoration only, unless the seat graph is rebuilt server-side.
